key_insight: Lie-AS-ISC uses PDE Lie symmetries to guide adaptive sampling and improve physics-informed neural network accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The framework could improve mesh-free PDE solvers in engineering by targeting training points beyond conventional uniform sampling.
method: Use Lie symmetry transformations to derive solution–variable relationships and construct basis points with exact solutions.
Adapt sampling using both absolute error and invariant surface conditions.
Introduce a dual-index loss to strengthen training constraints.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistently higher accuracy than existing methods in experiments, but provides no benchmarks, numerical gains, or computational costs.
watch_item: Applicability depends on identifying usable PDE Lie symmetries and constructing the required exact-solution basis points.
paper_title: Lie Symmetry-Guided Adaptive Sampling for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
